name: Aurora Anguilla Resort & Golf Club
positioning: Large beach and golf resort on Rendezvous Bay and Merrywing Bay in Anguilla, with a Greg Norman-designed golf course, a waterpark and a hydroponic farm supplying its restaurants
best_for: Families who want a waterpark, kids club and lots of activities on site
Golfers who want a Greg Norman-designed course at the resort
Travelers who like several restaurants to choose from without leaving the resort

facts.text: Merrywing Bay is a stretch of beach directly in front of the resort, known for calm waters, golden sand and sunsets.
Rendezvous Bay looks across the channel to St. Martin.
Accommodations include luxury rooms, suites, villas and estate homes.
Estate guests have private swimming pools.
The resort has six dining options ranging from casual to upscale.
Chef's Table serves family-style feasts prepared in an open kitchen and wood-burning oven.
Tokyo Bay is Executive Chef Joe Richardson's modern take on classic Japanese cuisine, with sushi and sashimi.
Sole di Mare serves Mediterranean dishes including handmade pastas and pizzas, with views of the sea and Saint Martin.
The International Course's 18th hole begins with a tee shot over a salt pond and climbs forty feet to a green guarded by three bunkers.
The Aurora Entertainment Park includes a tennis center, pickleball courts, a climbing wall, beach volleyball, clay bocce, basketball courts and a 9-hole mini golf course.
All non-motorized watersport rentals are complimentary and available daily at Rendezvous Beach.
Guided cave tours are run in partnership with the Anguilla National Trust and Katouche Tours.

highlights.text: The resort's golf club has a Greg Norman Signature Design 18-hole International Course and a 9-hole short course, Avalon Links.
Menus draw on the resort's 10,000-square-foot hydroponic gardens, which supply produce, herbs and fruit every day.
The pool complex has a splash pad, zero-entry pool, lazy river, slide tower and cabanas.
Sorana Spa has twelve treatment rooms, including two couples suites, with views of Rendezvous Beach.
The Aurora Explorers Club offers supervised activities for young guests, including arts and crafts, games and storytelling.

considerations.text: The resort offers water transfer options to and from St. Maarten.
A new beach club is due to debut in November 2026.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the exclusive positioning.
